about_the_game:
This content, created in collaboration with the animation "The Ravages of Time", enables players to use the officer data of Liaoyuan Huo and Sima Yi in game scenarios. Liaoyuan Huo, leader of the organization of assassins called "Handicapped Warriors", wields weapons like spears and throwing knives and concocts unconventional schemes. Sima Yi commands the members of the "Handicapped Warriors" like weapons, and makes use of a multi-faceted and ingenious intellect in his strategies, schemes, and management.

Note: The officer data of the two officers included in this DLC cannot be edited.

Additional Officers
Liaoyuan Huo and Sima Yi

How to Access
To play through scenarios with these officers, select New Game, Officers or Scenarios, Officer Settings, and then Add Original Officers.
Once the officers have been added, they can be assigned to a city and force via Place Original Officers.
